result.summary: The diff replaces requiredRoles.every(role => userRoles.includes(role)) with requiredRoles.some(role => userRoles.includes(role)) in src/access.ts. This inverts the documented authorization semantics and does not preserve behavior. It violates the contract in two ways: (1) access now requires only one of the required roles rather than all of them, and (2) an empty requiredRoles array now denies access instead of permitting it. Both defects are introduced by the single changed line and are high-confidence.
